title: Orders pagination skips rows — page 1 starts at the wrong record
body: list_orders is 1-indexed by page, but page 1 currently skips the first per_page rows (we seeded ids 1..9, page 1 with per_page 3 should return ids 1,2,3 but returns 4,5,6). Every page is shifted by one page worth of rows.
bug: list_orders computes offset as page * per_page instead of (page - 1) * per_page.
